_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-sitemap.mjs — do not edit by hand. Person files that fail the publication floor on the repo's data alone and would clear it with pipeline positions (stance cards promoted from Evidence Locker items, served by /api/stated-positions). n = pipeline positions needed (PDXPublicationFloor.pipelineNeed), k = issue keys the curated list already carries (a pipeline card there does not count), a = other ids a pipeline card may be filed under. Read by netlify/edge-functions/sitemap-bill-pages.ts, which adds /p/<pid> to /sitemap.xml for each row that has enough.
